title: Director Solutions Platform, UK
description:

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Role Purpose

The Platform Operations Director is responsible for ensuring that solutions developed and released for the Solutions team are operationally ready, properly tested, clearly documented, effectively released, and provide support once live.

The role acts as the bridge between delivery, business readiness and BAU operations. It supports the transition of work from project delivery into stable operational use, ensuring that users, stakeholders and support teams understand what has changed, how to use it, how to raise issues, and how ongoing support will be managed with appropriate priority, impact and SLAs

This role is particularly important as Solutions Integration moves from a more reactive service model into a structured product and agile delivery function. The Platform Operations Director owns QA, release management, documentation, stakeholder communication, support processes, training, adoption and post-release improvement including BAU bugs and triage.

The role works closely with Product Owners, Scrum Master, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Platform Operations, and business stakeholders to make sure delivery does not stop at “built”, but continues through testing, launch, adoption, support and measurable operational value.

Senior / Specialist-Level Expectations

As a Director within the team, this role is expected to help define and improve the operating standards around BAU management, QA coordination, release readiness, business readiness and service transition. Manage and proactively manage risk, resolution SLAs and ensure we are adhering to platform operational best practices.

The Platform Operations Director should be able to identify operational risks early, challenge whether a solution is genuinely ready for release, and recommend practical improvements to processes, documentation, testing, support models and stakeholder communications.

For smaller initiatives, the role should be able to advise Product Owners and delivery teams on the appropriate level of QA, training, release planning, handover and BAU support required. For larger or more complex initiatives, the role should escalate risks, dependencies or readiness gaps to the Product Manager Lead, Scrum Master, Lead Engineer / Solutions Architect or relevant leadership stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. BAU Operations Management

  • Own and coordinate BAU operational processes for assigned platforms, tools, reports, workflows and solutions across all Media solutions.
  • Monitor recurring issues, support trends, operational risks and user pain points.
  • Triage and prioritise BAU requests, incidents, defects and enhancement requests.
  • Ensure BAU work is captured through the agreed intake and backlog process rather than unmanaged emails, verbal requests or fragmented ticket routes.
  • Work with Product Owners and the Scrum Master to distinguish between BAU support, defects, enhancements and new product requirements.
  • Maintain visibility of BAU demand and help identify where recurring issues should become product improvements or engineering fixes.
  • Support continuous improvement of support processes, documentation and operational workflows.

This links directly to the team’s wider shift away from fragmented request routes and towards clearer delivery rhythms, structured backlogs and improved operational process discipline. The existing documentation notes the need for clearer team rhythms, sprint cadences, retrospectives and mentoring as part of the transition plan .

2. QA Coordination and Testing Readiness

  • Coordinate QA activity across delivery workstreams, ensuring testing requirements are understood before development begins.
  • Work with Product Owners to ensure acceptance criteria, test scenarios and success measures are clearly defined.
  • Support test planning across functional testing, regression testing, data validation, reporting checks and user acceptance testing.
  • Ensure defects are logged, prioritised, tracked and resolved through the agreed delivery process.
  • Work with engineers, analysts and business users to validate that solutions meet functional, operational and reporting requirements.
  • Support the creation of reusable QA checklists, test scripts and validation templates.
  • Ensure solutions are not released without appropriate testing evidence and business sign-off.

This is consistent with the Product Owner responsibilities already defined around testing requirements, success criteria, UAT coordination, business validation, release readiness and operational handover . The Platform Operations Specialist would support and operationalise those activities.

3. Business Readiness and Adoption

  • Ensure business users and operational teams are ready to adopt new or changed solutions.
  • Coordinate training, guidance, demos, FAQs, release notes and user communications.
  • Work with Product Owners to identify impacted teams, users, processes and workflows.
  • Confirm that business teams understand what is changing, why it is changing, when it is happening and what action is required.
  • Support stakeholder communications before, during and after release.
  • Gather early feedback from users and ensure issues are captured and prioritised appropriately.
  • Help ensure delivered solutions are embedded into day-to-day operations, rather than remaining underused or misunderstood.

The handover documentation highlights the importance of clear communication with users, proper release notes, demonstrations and adoption support for new features and solutions . This role should own the operational discipline around making that happen consistently.

4. Release Readiness and Service Transition

  • Own or coordinate release readiness checklists for assigned solutions.
  • Ensure each release has appropriate testing evidence, documentation, support ownership, training material and stakeholder communication.
  • Coordinate operational handover from delivery teams into BAU support.
  • Confirm that runbooks, troubleshooting guides, known issues and escalation routes are in place.
  • Work with engineering and data teams to ensure monitoring, alerting or manual checks are defined where required.
  • Support go-live planning, release scheduling and post-release hypercare.
  • Track post-release issues and ensure learnings are fed back into future delivery cycles.

This role should become the person asking:

“Are we actually ready to put this live, support it, explain it, and measure whether it worked?”

5. Documentation and Knowledge Management

  • Maintain clear operational documentation for platforms, reports, tools, processes and workflows.
  • Support the creation of user guides, SOPs, runbooks, release notes, FAQs and support documentation.
  • Ensure documentation is stored in the agreed location and kept up to date.
  • Work with Product Owners, engineers and analysts to document key dependencies, business rules, known limitations and support processes.
  • Help reduce reliance on individual knowledge by making processes and system behaviour transparent.
  • Support onboarding of new team members by maintaining accessible knowledge resources.

This is important because the team is moving away from legacy ways of working and informal knowledge transfer into a more structured operating model.

6. Platform and Process Governance

  • Support the consistent use of agreed tools, workflows, ticketing processes and delivery governance.
  • Help ensure work is captured, categorised and progressed through the correct routes.
  • Maintain standards for BAU tickets, defects, release requests, support issues and operational change.
  • Identify process gaps, duplicated effort or inconsistent ways of working.
  • Recommend improvements to BAU processes, support models, QA standards and release governance.
  • Support reporting on operational performance, support demand, defect trends and release readiness.
  • Help ensure changes are controlled, documented and aligned to agreed team practices.

This aligns with the documented need to improve proactive behaviour, structured product management, backlog grooming, stand-ups and retrospectives across the team .

7. Stakeholder and Cross-Team Coordination

  • Work closely with Product Owners, Engineering, Data, Reporting, QA, Scrum Master and business users.
  • Coordinate with Activation, Operations, Channel Development, Commercial and other impacted teams where relevant.
  • Ensure operational dependencies are understood and managed before release.
  • Help stakeholders understand support routes, known issues, timelines and release impacts.
  • Escalate operational risks, unresolved defects, readiness gaps or business adoption concerns.
  • Support regular BAU and platform operations updates for leadership where required.

The existing Product Owner documentation already describes the importance of coordination across engineering, data, reporting, platform, operations and business teams . The Platform Operations Specialist should provide the operational control layer that supports this.

title: Lead Engineer/ Architect (.NET) - Finance Group
description: This is a remote position. About Embrace Finance Group Embrace Finance Group, the financial-services division of Embrace Software Inc., helps every institution - from regional banks to local credit unions - deliver the speed, intelligence and experience customers now expect in a digital world. Today we serve nearly 450 financial institutions and hundreds of local government agencies. We are building an AI-led unified financial services platform spanning digital banking, document automation, item processing and branch modernization, engineered in partnership with the Embrace AI Group. The next generation of our online banking solution is a cornerstone of that platform - and this role will lead it. The Role We are hiring a Lead Engineer/ Architect (.NET), a hands-on technical leader who will accelerate the build-out of the next generation of our online banking platform for US Banks and credit unions on ASP.NET Core and C#. You will spend a significant portion of your time writing production code and owning architecture, while also mentoring engineers and setting the technical bar. You will partner day-to-day with Finance Group technology leaders on product and delivery, the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and DevOps standards and Venture Labs / the Embrace AI Group to bring emerging capabilities into the platform. At its core this is a forward-deployed engineering (FDE) practice with an AI-first, new-product mandate. You will embed with financial institutions and internal product partners, turn ambiguous problems into shipped product and lead a small team of highly empowered, highly skilled engineers who take ideas from conceptualization to launch in weeks - not quarters. You will go full-stack from modern UX/UI through public REST APIs down to a .NET control plane and treat large language models and agentic AI services as first-class building blocks of the platform rather than bolt-ons. Key Responsibilities Architect and hands-on build the new ASP.NET Core / C# online banking platform - system design, service boundaries, data modeling and API contracts. Design and implement critical features and platform components; lead code and design reviews, setting the technical bar. Lead and mentor a small agile team - run sprints, unblock engineers, own delivery commitments, coach through 1:1s and pair programming. Partner with Finance Group technology leaders, product, QA and security to translate business and regulatory needs into robust solutions. Collaborate with the Embrace Technology group on shared architecture, cloud and CI/CD standards and with Venture Labs / Embrace AI Group to embed AI capabilities (AI-assisted dev, predictive insights, fraud/risk monitoring) into the platform. Drive engineering best practices - testing, CI/CD and adoption of modern AI dev tools. Operate as a forward-deployed engineer - embed with internal product partners to co-design solutions, then rapidly conceptualize, prototype and launch new products, compressing concept-to-production from quarters to weeks. Lead AI-first, new-product development end-to-end - design and ship LLM- and agent-powered capabilities using services such as Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI (and Azure OpenAI) and orchestration frameworks like LangChain, with disciplined evaluation, guardrails and cost / latency management. Build full-stack and real-time - modern, accessible UX/UI, public REST APIs and live experiences via SignalR on .NET Core / C# control plane, with event-driven services through Azure Service Bus / messaging, etc. Own the cloud and delivery foundation - infrastructure-as-code with Terraform, CI/CD on GitHub (Actions) and containerized, repeatable deployments across Azure and/or AWS. Engineer security and compliance in by design - identity and access management (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management and data protection aligned to PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC, with auditability from day one. Build and empower the team - recruit, coach and unblock a small squad of progressive FDEs, giving them the autonomy, tooling and technical bar to ship safely and fast. How We Work - Forward-Deployed & AI-First Small, empowered squads: highly skilled FDEs own outcomes end-to-end, from conceptualization to launch, with minimal hand-offs. AI-first by default: LLMs, RAG and agentic workflows are first-class both as design tools and as product capabilities - we prototype with AI, evaluate rigorously and ship. Fast and safe: short iteration loops, trunk-based development, automated testing, infrastructure-as-code and progressive delivery behind feature flags. Polyglot pragmatism: .NET / C# anchors the control plane; we use the best-fit language or service elsewhere and optimize for outcomes, not dogma. Our Stack & Tooling Control plane & services: .NET (ASP.NET Core, C#), public REST APIs, SignalR for real-time, Azure Service Bus for messaging and eventing. AI & LLM: Google Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI / Azure OpenAI, LangChain and similar orchestration; vector stores, RAG, plus evaluation and guardrail tooling. Cloud & platform: Azure and/or AWS, Terraform for IaC, GitHub + GitHub Actions for CI/CD and containers. Front-end: modern, accessible UX/UI (Angular / React). Identity, security & compliance: IAM (OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO, MFA), secrets management, PCI DSS, SOC 2 and FFIEC. Data: Microsoft SQL Server today, with modern data stores adopted as the platform evolves. Requirements 5+ years building modern, data-intensive .NET web applications, with a proven tech-lead / lead-developer track record and direct team ownership. Polyglot. Expert-level C# and .NET (Framework and modern .NET / Core); strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server; solid REST API experience at scale. Proven experience in financial services / online banking, with strong preference for platforms serving US Banks, credit unions, or other regulated FIs. Front-end experience with modern Javascript/UI frameworks like Angular / React. Familiarity with classic frameworks like ASP.NET, Razor templates, Htmx, Bootstrap, Orchard Core, etc is a strong plus for modernizing. Experience with cloud (Azure, AWS), DevOps and CI/CD; understanding of US banking security and compliance (PCI DSS, SOC 2, FFIEC guidance). Strong communicator across engineering and business stakeholders (Finance Group, Embrace Technology, Venture Labs); excellent ownership and problem-solving. Comfortable in a highly remote, fast-paced, agile environment. Bachelor's in CS, Software Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience). Demonstrated 0→1 product delivery at speed - ideally in a forward-deployed, customer-embedded, or startup / venture environment. Hands-on AI/LLM application development - prompt and context engineering, RAG and agentic patterns on at least one major platform (Vertex AI / Gemini, OpenAI, or Azure OpenAI) with orchestration such as LangChain and a pragmatic grasp of evaluation, guardrails and cost. Real-time and event-driven experience - SignalR, Azure Service Bus or equivalent messaging - and public REST API design at scale. Strong platform / DevOps depth - Terraform (IaC), GitHub Actions CI/CD, containerization and multi-cloud (Azure and/or AWS). Identity, security and compliance depth for regulated FIs - IAM / OAuth2 / OIDC, SSO / MFA, secrets management and PCI DSS / SOC 2 / FFIEC. Benefits Competitive salary commensurate with experience; 100% remote with autonomy. Career advancement across the Embrace portfolio; the chance to shape a platform used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions with the Embrace AI Group and Venture Labs. A high-autonomy, AI-first engineering culture where small teams of empowered FDEs take ideas from concept to launch - and see them used by hundreds of US banks and credit unions.
